family.description: Endoribonuclease active on single-stranded mRNA. Inhibits protein synthesis by cleavage of mRNA [[cite:PUB00007949]]. Previously thought to inhibit protein synthesis initiation [[cite:PUB00002939]]. This protein may also be involved in the regulation of purine biosynthesis [[cite:PUB00007948]]. YjgF (renamed RidA) family members are enamine/imine deaminases. They hydrolyze reactive intermediates released by PLP-dependent enzymes, including threonine dehydratase [[cite:PUB00064878]]. YjgF also prevents inhibition of transaminase B (IlvE) in Salmonella [[cite:PUB00109184]].
family.name: Endoribonuclease L-PSP

causal_graphs.context: Figure 2B of the 2012 study; 0.9 uM IlvA, 1.6 uM RidA when present, 10 uM PLP, threonine series, 50 mM each TAPS/CHES/CAPS at pH 9.5, 200 uL, 22 C. A230 initial rates use 30-60 s at this pH. Doses are monomer-based. Two replicates with SE, representative of more than five independent experiments.

evidence.explanation: Figure 2B and the kinetic Methods support the added-RidA comparison at pH 9.5. The high-pH rate window is 30-60 s, not the initial burst.
Maps the Salmonella reference to PF01042; identity evidence is not a separate causal experiment or proof of every experimental clone sequence.

edges.mechanism: Adding RidA increases the measured keto-acid production rate relative to IlvA without RidA across the tested substrate series. IlvA, substrate and assay cofactors remain explicit joint conditions; this is not a RidA-only reaction or an elementary chemical step.
edges.subject: rida-added-to-ilva-threonine

causal_graphs.family_mapping: LT2 reference UniProtKB:Q7CP78, ridA/yjgF/STM4458, 128 residues, sequence version 1, agrees exactly with InterPro; PF01042 spans 7-126 inclusive. Production in E. coli BL21AI does not change the Salmonella donor identity. Complete clone junctions remain unverified.
causal_graphs.limitations: Directness describes a measured coupled biochemical output. RidA alone is not asserted to dehydrate threonine. Separate TLC/MS support product identity, not direct visualization of an enamine, imine, water-positioning or proton-transfer trajectory. Frozen family labels do not assign this protein RNase activity or establish a universal family function.

causal_graphs.context: 10 mM threonine, 5 mM ferricyanide, 0.9 uM IlvA, 10 uM PLP, 1.6 uM RidA when present, 50 mM each TAPS/CHES/CAPS pH 9.5. Reduced ferricyanide is measured by A420 and 2-ketobutyrate by DNPH derivatization. Two replicates with SD, representative of four independent endpoint experiments. Dedicated endpoint-method temperature is not specified.

evidence.explanation: Figure 4B rightmost pair and accompanying Results show less ferricyanide reduction with RidA at 5 mM ferricyanide; no exact value was digitized.

edges.mechanism: The RidA-containing reaction reduces less ferricyanide than the matched reaction lacking RidA at the two-hour endpoint. Intermediate removal is an interpretation of this trapping result, not a directly imaged molecular trajectory.
edges.subject: rida-in-ferricyanide-assay

evidence.explanation: Figure 4B product bars and the right-pair Results comparison support higher product yield with RidA, with DNPH rather than A230 quantitation.

edges.mechanism: Under the same trapping conditions, adding RidA increases the keto-acid endpoint yield. This measured product redistribution is not presented as independent evidence that each proposed hydrolytic microstep was observed.
edges.subject: rida-in-ferricyanide-assay

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Intact LT2 RidA Q7CP78, sequence version 1, contains PF01042 at 7-126; IlvA maps to P20506. Tags and reference mapping are established, but complete clone junctions remain unverified.
causal_graphs.limitations: Two outputs from one experiment are not independent replication or a serial observed pathway. Ferricyanide trapping supports accessible reactive intermediates but does not directly resolve their structure or RidA catalytic microsteps. DNPH avoids ferricyanide interference at A230. Temperatures of other assays are not silently transferred to this endpoint.

causal_graphs.context: 15 mM threonine, 0.9 uM IlvA, 1.6 uM WT or variant RidA, 50 mM CHES pH 9.5. General kinetic conditions include 10 uM PLP, 200 uL, 22 C and the 30-60 s rate window. Output is the fold increase over IlvA alone. Three replicates with SD, representative of three independent experiments. The separate pH 8 HEPES bars are not merged into this context.

evidence.explanation: Figure 6 gray Y17F and WT bars support this substitution-specific comparison at pH 9.5; no atomic model is adopted as observed evidence.

edges.mechanism: Y17F gives less coupled product-rate enhancement than WT at equal nominal monomer concentration, without abolishing the enhancement or establishing a unique residue-level chemical role.
edges.subject: y17f-in-coupled-assay

evidence.explanation: Figure 6 gray R105A and WT bars support the decrease. The source notes residual enhancement and burst kinetics, which qualify an essential-catalyst interpretation.

edges.mechanism: R105A gives less coupled product-rate enhancement than WT and is the lowest of the tested variants. This does not make all residual activity zero or directly demonstrate an imine-binding pose.
edges.subject: r105a-in-coupled-assay

evidence.explanation: Figure 6 gray E120K and WT bars are the adopted comparison; distinct pH 8 measurements remain separate.

edges.mechanism: E120K lowers the enhancement relative to WT at pH 9.5 while retaining activity. The perturbation effect does not directly identify general acid/base chemistry or water orientation.
edges.subject: e120k-in-coupled-assay

evidence.explanation: Figure 6 gray E120A and WT bars support this decrease with retained activity.

edges.mechanism: E120A lowers the enhancement relative to WT at pH 9.5 but remains above IlvA alone. A measured substitution effect is not a direct view of an elementary catalytic step.
edges.subject: e120a-in-coupled-assay

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Q7CP78 sequence version 1 contains Y17, R105 and E120 within PF01042 residues 7-126. Intact C-terminally His6-tagged QuikChange variants use the same purification approach as WT; exact clones remain unsequenced in this assessment.
causal_graphs.limitations: Each substitution reduces, but does not eliminate, measured enhancement. Activity changes do not uniquely resolve water positioning, an essential acid/base residue or an isolated-domain mechanism. Purification and reported stability do not independently establish identical folding or active-protein fraction. R105A retains burst kinetics and has the lowest enhancement.

evidence.explanation: Figure 7 and the serine Results support the direction. The quoted prose includes a particular comparison, but the graph does not digitize rates or impose that fold change across concentrations.

edges.mechanism: Adding RidA increases pyruvate production rate across the measured serine series compared with IlvA without RidA. This observed coupled output does not independently make RidA sufficient for serine dehydration.
edges.subject: rida-added-to-ilva-serine

causal_graphs.family_mapping: LT2 reference RidA Q7CP78 sequence version 1 contains PF01042 at 7-126, with exact UniProt/InterPro sequence agreement. The intact protein and IlvA P20506 are the mapped coupled system; full clone junctions remain unverified.
causal_graphs.limitations: The endpoint supports enhanced product formation in a coupled assay. The corresponding reactive metabolite, hydrolysis sequence and proposed catalytic water geometry are not directly observed by A230. Results are not transferred to all family members or mammalian RNase function.

causal_graphs.context: 50 mM potassium phosphate pH 9, 50 uM PLP, 12.5 mM 2-ketoglutarate, 0.75 ug IlvE, 10 ug IlvA, 50 mM serine and 16 ug RidA where indicated. Methods list these mixtures preincubated 2 h at 37 C, then 5 mM radiolabeled isoleucine (20 nCi) for 15 min at 37 C. TLC-resolved 2-keto-3-methylvalerate reports IlvE specific activity. Two replicates with ranges, independently repeated at least twice.

evidence.explanation: Figure 1B Salmonella bar, Results and radioactive Methods establish the retained-activity comparison. The caption/Methods order discrepancy is explicitly retained rather than interpreted as proven repair.

edges.mechanism: The RidA-containing IlvA/serine mixture retains more IlvE activity than the matched inhibited mixture without RidA. This does not uniquely distinguish prevention from reversal given the source's addition-order ambiguity, or directly observe an adduct-removal mechanism.
edges.subject: rida-in-ilve-ilva-serine-assay

causal_graphs.family_mapping: Intact LT2 RidA Q7CP78 sequence version 1 contains PF01042 residues 7-126. IlvA P20506 and IlvE P0A1A5 are LT2 reference mappings. IlvE carries a C-terminal His6 tag and was produced in SB300A1-derived Salmonella strains; RidA/IlvA purification cites earlier procedures. Complete clones remain unverified.
causal_graphs.limitations: Figure 1B caption wording places RidA addition after preincubation, whereas Methods include it in the preincubation mixture and Results interpret protection. The graph adopts the endpoint comparison, not reversal of pre-existing damage. The separate 3-chloroalanine assay is not an identical control. Adduct identity, nucleophilic site and raw MS were not independently resolved.
